tokens.name: concrete
tokens.usage: Page ground. Everything sits on concrete.

tokens.name: slab
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, inputs and table rows: anything bordered that holds content.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: code blocks, empty matrix cells, meter tracks, disabled controls.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, every border and rule, and the hard shadow. On concrete, slab and sunk: 12.5:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, help text, labels. On concrete, slab and sunk: 5.9:1 or more in both themes. Never for anything a reviewer must read to decide.

tokens.name: quay
tokens.usage: Brand yellow, from quay-edge markings. Primary actions, 'Needs you', the Proposed state and the 'Not verified' line. A fill only: never text. Always inside an ink border.

tokens.name: on-quay
tokens.usage: Text on quay: 11.4:1.

tokens.name: buoy
tokens.usage: Lifebuoy orange. The Landing state: the queue is moving a change. A fill only, always bordered.

tokens.name: on-buoy
tokens.usage: Text on buoy: 5.3:1 light, 6.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: harbour
tokens.usage: Harbour blue. The Exploring state, agents at work, selection, and meter fills.

tokens.name: on-harbour
tokens.usage: Text on harbour: 7.5:1 light, 5.9:1 dark. Dark text in dark theme because the fill is lighter.

tokens.name: landed
tokens.usage: Starboard green. The Landed state only. 3.5:1 lighter than escalated, so the two differ by lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: on-landed
tokens.usage: Text on landed: 8.8:1.

tokens.name: escalated
tokens.usage: Port red. The Escalated state, conflicts, and destructive actions. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: on-escalated
tokens.usage: Text on escalated: 7.4:1.

tokens.name: vouched
tokens.usage: The Vouched state: an ink stamp. Fill only.

tokens.name: on-vouched
tokens.usage: Text on vouched: 14.5:1 light, 15.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link text, always underlined. On concrete, slab and sunk: 5.1:1 or more light, 7.3:1 or more dark.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error messages and over-budget figures as text. On concrete, slab and sunk: 5.0:1 or more light, 6.8:1 or more dark. Always starts with a word such as 'Error:'.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 3px outline, 3px out. 5.1:1 or more on every light surface, 10.3:1 or more on every dark one.

families.body: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", Verdana, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Archivo at its widest (125%), cut as static files. Headlines and labels only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero lines on the site and title cards in the video. One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles: Inbox, Task, Change, Landed.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Set in uppercase. Buttons, state chips, field labels, table headers.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, drawn for low-vision readers. All reading text.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: The queue re-checks trunk before writing.
styles.usage: The human record and other text a reviewer must read.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two attempts can land at once and the second overwrites the first.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Escalated: which retry limit do you want?
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text. Use instead of italics for anything important.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata and help text. The smallest reading size.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono. Anything a machine wrote: paths, trailers, IDs, money, counts.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Figures in tables, meters and chips. Use tabular numbers.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: Totals and the figure that matters in a row.

spacing.note: 4px base, 8px module. Everything snaps to 8 except chip insides.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a chip's marker and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding. Side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards. Desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above page titles.

radius.note: Square. Berth has no rounded corners anywhere.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every element.

shadow.note: One shadow: a hard 4px offset in the ink colour, no blur. It marks what you can press or what is moving.

tokens.name: shadow-block
tokens.usage: Buttons at rest, the card being reviewed, and the change currently landing.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: Buttons while pressed (they also move 3px down and right).

border.note: Borders do the work shadows and fills do elsewhere.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers between table rows.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Every control, chip, card and panel.

tokens.name: border-heavy
tokens.usage: The trunk lane, page-title underlines, and the bottom of key hints.
